evidence.name: Screen field: Joiner between wheel values
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Joiner between wheel values" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Joiner between wheel values
sections.description: The character or characters used to join selections from multiple wheels into one combined value — for example '/' turns two wheels into 'Large/Red', or a space joins them with a gap. This only matters when you have more than one wheel; leave it as-is for a single-wheel picker. Choose a separator that reads naturally in the answer you'll store and reuse later in the funnel.
